headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 9, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Meanwhile, the Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing the game 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Griffin Jax of the Tampa Bay Rays, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. Other players affected by injuries include Cooper Pratt of the Milwaukee Brewers, Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, Cole Wilcox of the Seattle Mariners, Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins, Slade Cecconi of the Cleveland Guardians, and Chris Murphy of the Chicago White Sox.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. The Athletics also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds, striking out 4 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing the game 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kyle Schwarber leading the offense by hitting two home runs and driving in four runs. Jesús Luzardo pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Blue Jays, striking out 12 batters and allowing just two earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-handed pitcher Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, who was traded to the team. Berry joins the Royals after being acquired in a trade.
